newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Accel starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Accel starts as buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it had started coverage of Mexico's Accel SA de CV with a rating of buy.

-- Analysts Sebastien Chatel and Jorge Beristain wrote in a Jan 27 report that they had set a 12-month price target of three pesos a share, representing a nominal peso return of 62 percent and a dollar return of 41 percent.
-- "Accel offers a means of participating in the booming maquiladora industry and the domestic retail recovery," they wrote.
-- Accel is a holding company with maquiladora contract manufacturing operations along the U.S.-Mexican border, warehousing and distribution throughout Mexico and a U.S. garment division.
-- The company's shares were up 0.05 peso to 1.83 in Mexico City on Tuesday.
